agent.menu:
I am answering in a simplified mode right now. I can:
1) show free apartments,
2) calculate an installment plan,
3) call a manager.
agent.refusal: I can’t help with that. I can find an apartment, calculate installments or call a manager.
agent.injection: I can help with choosing, calculations and booking under the complex’s rules. I can’t change prices or terms — the sales team decides that.
